senses.gloss:
कौप a. (पी f.) [कूप-अण्]
Relating to or coming from a well (as
water).
--पं Well-water.

कौपीनं [कूप-खञ्; see Sk. on
[]
P. V. 2. 20]
1 The pudenda.
--2 A
privity, privy part.
--3 A small
piece of cloth (usually a small
strip) worn over the privities;
कौपीनं शतखंडजर्जरतरं कंथा पुनस्तादृशी
Bh. 3. 101.
--4 (Hence sometimes)
A ragged or tattered garment.
--5
Sin, an improper or wrong act;
Pt. 3. 97.
